## Chinese Hedge Funds Rotate Out of Nvidia and US Hyperscalers in AI Trade

Coordinated institutional selling by Chinese funds in NVDA and hyperscalers signals geopolitical risk is being actively repriced into positioning — not just flagged as a tail risk — which could create near-term technical overhang on AI darlings independent of fundamentals.

- Chinese hedge funds are actively reducing exposure to Nvidia and US hyperscaler positions, per the headline.
- The rotation is framed as a geopolitical risk repricing of the broader AI trade rather than a fundamental reassessment.
- No specific fund names, position sizes, or timing are disclosed in coverage.
- US-China tensions are cited as the macro driver underlying the positioning shift.
